regions.today: Warm and humid this evening with a few sunny spells. Duller and less warm over southern parts with some light rain.
regions.tonight: Humid and largely dry tonight with clear spells. A little light rain or drizzle is possible. Temperatures will not fall below 14 to 17 degrees in light southwesterly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Largely dry to begin tomorrow. Some rain for a time in the afternoon, followed by drier and brighter conditions in the evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 23 degrees, warmest in the southeast, in light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high Tuesday and Wednesday.
